intro.text: A scoutlord for Highprince Dalinar Kholin who reports to Dalinar or Adolin on what the scouts have found.

items.text: Tarilar was there when a chasmfiend unexpectedly climbed onto the wrong plateau during Elhokar's hunt.

appearance.text: He has a gaunt face, a thick chest and arms, and a head that from some angles looks too small for his body.
